plugins.name: loomwright
plugins.description: Loomwright is a plan-first, multi-agent development system for Claude Code. Launch Pad turns a goal into a reviewed brief; Supervisor executes it autonomously across parallel git worktrees with self-heal; dedicated agents cover code review, red-teaming, QA, and standalone PR review-and-heal. 14 agent roles, 25 slash commands, 42 skills, 48 quality gate hooks. Full history in CHANGELOG.md.

plugins.name: stackpack
plugins.description: Stackpack — generic tech-stack reference skills (Next.js, NestJS, API-gateway patterns, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker) spun out of Loomwright; 18 skills, no agents/commands/hooks. Install alongside loomwright@atelier.

plugins.name: mysql-mcp
plugins.description: Mysql-mcp v1.0.1 — the read-only MySQL MCP server (vikashruhil-mysql-mcp via uvx) spun out of Loomwright, pinned to `==1.0.1`. Resolves DB_HOST/DB_USER/DB_PASS/DB_NAME(/DB_PORT) from the environment. No agents/commands/skills/hooks.

plugins.name: loomwright-lanes
plugins.description: Optional live pane for Loomwright's /automate --parallel lanes: /lanes shows every lane (its current step on a seven-step rail, start time, state, PR, branch, readiness, machine load and keep-awake) and answers a waiting lane's question with one button per option. Reads and writes only through Loomwright's lane-status / lane-feed / lane-answer; uninstalling it changes nothing about a run.
